entities.summary: American singer Zendaya has released one studio album, 10 singles, three promotional singles, 15 music videos and some album appearances. In 2011, Zendaya independently released her debut single, "Swag It Out". Her next single, "Watch Me", peaked at number 86 on the US Billboard Hot 100.
